scope: Minimum Governance Compilation Core semantics and lifecycle obligations.
assurance_requirements: Claim evidence at its actual level; do not substitute finite checks for proof or conformance for legal compliance.
runtime_dependencies: Runtime consumer must preserve required semantics for any package it claims to consume.
compatibility_rules: Unknown mandatory authority/evidence/closure extensions are incompatible.
invalidation_conditions: Material change to source, interpretation, authority, invariant, model, compiler, profile, package, or runtime interface requires impact analysis.
limitations: Core profile does not establish legal compliance or deployment non-bypassability.
